info.title: Fenergo Nebula Association Command
info.description:
**Association Command API**:


Association Command API provides endpoints in order to manage and configure all entity associations.


**Association Command API provides**:
  • Entity Association Management
  • Unwrapping Requirement Status Model Management

post.summary: Starts an asynchronous measure-completeness calculation and returns immediately
post.description:
Creates a BusinessProcess, publishes a service-task event to start the state machine, and returns the business process id. Poll `GET /api/association-business-process/{businessProcessId}` for the result. Each call starts an independent calculation with its own id; there is no server-side superseding, so a second call for the same journey and entity does not affect the first. Concurrent runs are last-writer-wins on the domain model, and the UI collapses duplicate triggers client-side.

Required permissions:
At least one of the following permissions is required: AssociationEdit, AssociationEditAndPartialDelete, AssociationEditOnly, AssociationEditAndLinkOnly, AssociationAccess

parameters.description: The UiD of the tenant representing organization
